review.notes: Full re-review (2314 lines changed since a60ff1d). All nine findings of the previous review are repaired (R09 with one new misattribution). Gate at head passes every check; lake env lean of Suggested.lean exits 0 with 27 sorry warnings only; depcheck --movable: 204 roadmaps, 1656 edges, 0 problems; pins mathlib f6090c7 / TauCeti 358314d. Seeded sample of 15 targets checked: Mathlib names opened at the pin (sheafPushforwardCocontinuous, Point.Hom.hom direction, HasEnoughPoints and its J.over instance, Sublocale/nucleusIsoSublocale, Opens.grothendieckTopology, closure operators, no QuasiSober product instance, no PowerObject/IsLocallyConnectedSite); AdicSpacesPartII R0.19.10, SchemeAndStackFoundations 1.10/1.18/2.1-2.5/2.9-2.17, RigidAnalyticGeometry 8.3 resolved on main a0ad405; HomotopyTheoryOfCategories #1521 line 66; Isbell 1981 Thm 1-2 and intro, Hofmann-Lawson Def 4.1, Isbell 1972 2.3(3) read in the cache; SGA 4, Elephant, Mac Lane-Moerdijk, Stone Spaces and the other books not readable legally. One-tactic probe: all 27 sorried theorems fail, no padding. Ownership grep over 439 open PRs and main: no other owner. Adversarial table of 44 rows with computed values. Blocking: R01 (P2) 6.3 claims local coherence (= R0.19.10's IsAlgebraic, which requires the generators' structural maps quasiseparated, i.e. quasicompact diagonals) for precoherent C with pullbacks only; the fibre of the diagonal of a generator over a parallel pair is an equalizer subsheaf that is representable only with equalizers in C, and 6.4's headline inherits the gap through 'in particular' (headline itself true by the slice route). P3: 3.1 Check names the wrong non-sheaf, 3.3 Check witness is for faithfulness, redundant inferable Kan-extension binder in exists_of_isCocontinuous, Isbell 1981 Thm 2 misattributed the Q and Q+sqrt2 instance and Isbell 1972 lacks a locator, 8.1 route lacks the site-presentation step.
